verdict.rationale: Checkout.com's issuing page documents funding cards at authorization time, which avoids pre-funding. It can also send authorization requests to the customer's system for complete control, which covers the just-in-time side of the story. However, the evidence never presents prefunded balances as a selectable issuing funding mode, and no cash-flow tradeoff documentation appears beyond the marketing line about avoiding pre-funding complexity. Missing for 10: explicit choice between prefunded and JIT funding models, documented cash-flow tradeoffs, in-depth technical docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can choose how transactions are funded — prefunded balances or just-in-time funding where my system approves and funds each authorization — with the cash-flow tradeoffs documented

citations.quote: Fund cards on authorization for instant use and without the complexity of pre-funding.
We can manage decisions for you with card checks and spend controls, or send requests to you for complete control.
Automate transaction outcomes with accept or reject logic based on your own rules.
